title: Live on Monad
text: Flip Garden runs live on Monad. Its ledger rebuilds a wallet's orders from the chain, reading the full history through Envio HyperSync, and checks them. On our example wallet, six checks agree with the chain, with a difference of zero.

title: Sign in with Face ID
text: Now a real iPhone and real funds on Monad. One Face ID prompt signs in with a Mera passkey. No wallet extension, no seed phrase.

title: Plant
text: Six dollars become a Kuru flip bid in three passkey-signed steps: approve, deposit, place. Each step is simulated first and checked on chain afterwards.

title: The garden grows
text: Each order is a plant. This account's earlier bids filled and flipped by themselves, so its garden already bears fruit.

title: Unwind
text: Unwind cancels every order and withdraws everything from Kuru to the wallet, again with one passkey signature per step.

title: Deposit from any chain
text: The next scenes run on simulated data, as the banner says. The Deposit tab asks Aurora for a quote and a one-time address. When the transfer is seen, the USDC arrives on Monad and the balance is read again from the chain.

title: Swap to AUSD
text: The Passkey tab swaps USDC into AUSD through Kuru Flow. Every step is simulated first, and sent only when you confirm.

title: Hedge
text: The coins that filled bids collect can be hedged. The Hedge tab shows size, collateral and cost, then opens a short on Perpl.

title: The Gardener
text: Then the Gardener. You confirm a mandate once: a budget, the allowed actions and an expiry. Inside it, the Gardener watches the garden and acts on its own, with Jev making the decisions. Every action lands in a timeline.

title: Leaderboard
text: The leaderboard ranks gardens by completed round trips, never by profit. Joining takes only a public address.

title: Flip Garden
text: Flip Garden. Plant, grow, hedge, and read the ledger.
